bagPolicy.summary: Only small clutches, wristlets, or fanny packs no bigger than 6" x 9" and clear plastic bags no bigger than 12" x 12" x 6" are allowed. All bags are subject to search upon entry.

bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: General admission parking is included with your ticket. For easier entry and exit, consider upgrading to Reserved Parking, Star Parking, or Star Parking Plus. Arrive early to avoid heavy traffic and long wait times.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in The Gorge Amphitheatre's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by The Gorge Amphitheatre, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry is not permitted at The Gorge except on selected festival events.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at The Gorge Amphitheatre. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at The Gorge Amphitheatre. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
